author: LowKeyMax
body: I was going to break a tower for a swastika somebody built so I could screenshot it for a report. 10 seconds later I was banned for a false report. Somebody unban me.
body_tagged: I was going to break a tower for a swastika somebody built so I could screenshot it for a report. 10 seconds later I was banned for a false report. Somebody unban me.
title: Really?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Well, that's what happened from my point of view:
Someone pointed out that a player is building a swastika, so I joined the other team to break it.
I broke one block and you walk in my way and say "dude" "im getting a mod".

Since the game just ended and you walked in my way, I assumed you built it.

The chat logs: http://pastebin.com/0X71fvmZ
Line 1: Someone points out that there is a swastika
Line 3: You write "IKR"
Line 15 & 16: You say "dude" "im getting a mod"
Line 41: You ask Oscar if building a swastika is against the rules (note the ": /" emoji).

replies.author: LowKeyMax
replies.body: Well I didn't know you were a mod and I was breaking the tower so I could screenshot it. So it was kinda a false ban.

replies.author: LowKeyMax
replies.body: And I would enjoy actually playing on the server. I did absolutely nothing to build that structure except attempting to report it.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Since I have no evidence that you built that thing.
I'll decide with the benefit of the doubt in mind that the infraction is false.
I'll get a Senior/Admin to delete the infraction.

Sorry for the inconvenience.
